art: A luminous minimal render: soft polar-light gradients in teal, violet and faint magenta over deep navy, frosted translucent planes with gentle depth, generous negative space. Calm and premium — never neon, never busy.

background.css: radial-gradient(60% 45% at 18% 0%, rgba(110,231,200,.16), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(55% 40% at 78% 8%, rgba(167,139,250,.15), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(45% 35% at 55% 90%, rgba(240,138,192,.08), transparent 70%), linear-gradient(180deg, #0d1124 0%, #0b0e1c 60%, #090b16 100%)

mood: A polar night sky over deep navy: soft teal, violet, and faint magenta light-curtains bleeding in from the edges of the background — luminous but never neon. Signatures to reproduce structurally: (1) cards, asides, and code blocks are frosted glass — translucent panels (rgba of --bg-2 at ~.55) with backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.2), a 1px inner border of rgba(255,255,255,.08), and generous border-radius (14–18px); (2) key headings and stat numbers take a subtle aurora gradient as text fill (background-clip: text, teal → violet), body text stays solid --ink; (3) hairline dividers are gradients that fade out at both ends, never hard rules; (4) one soft glow (box-shadow, wide and dim, in the accent hue) marks the single most important element per page — the focal point, chosen deliberately. Everything floats; nothing is boxed hard. The feel: a modern, premium product site that decided to become a calm, spacious book.
name: Aurora
tagline: Polar-night gradients and frosted glass — luminous, calm, premium
